name: heaven water sparrow
source:
a game about wanting to meet your fated partner who may or may not remember you, and about making a deal with heaven. whatever deal you must make.

[From [url=https://feyxuan.itch.io/heaven-water-sparrow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这款游戏讲述了想与命中注定的伴侣重逢的心愿，尽管对方未必还记得你；也讲述了与上天做交易的故事，无论必须付出什么代价。

[摘自[url=https://feyxuan.itch.io/heaven-water-sparrow]itch.io[/url]]
